rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice for something concerning or affecting the world as a whole.

example.english: The global economic downturn affects Hong Kong too.
example.traditional: 全世界嘅經濟唔景氣，香港都會受影響。
example.jyutping: cyun4 sai3 gaai3 ge3 ging1 zai3 m4 ging2 hei3 hoeng1 gong2 dou1 wui5 sau6 jing2 hoeng2

rows.note: Use this for the overall or comprehensive aspect of something rather than its worldwide reach.

example.english: We need a global assessment of this plan.
example.traditional: 我哋要全面檢討呢個計劃。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cyun4 min6 gim2 tou2 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this in computing when something is available throughout the entire system.

example.english: This variable is global, so every module can use it.
example.traditional: 呢個變數係全系統嘅，所有模組都用到。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 bin3 sou3 hai6 cyun4 hai6 tung2 ge3 so2 jau5 mou4 zou2 dou1 jung6 dou3
